request.prompt: A single glossy die-cut vinyl sticker of a small travel suitcase with a few travel stickers on it (stickers without text). Flat vector illustration with soft, minimal shading and chunky rounded shapes, bold dark eggplant (#2b1b3a) outlines, a limited warm palette of soft mint (#9ad7c2), cream (#faf9f6) and pink (#f5b3c8), a thick clean white sticker border all around the shape, and a very subtle soft drop shadow. Centered, isolated on a transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no coins. A retro hard-shell suitcase with rounded corners and a dark eggplant top handle. The little travel stickers on it are simple pink and cream shapes (a heart, a star, a wave): no words, no letters, no numbers, no flags, no luggage-tag text. Everything sits inside one single continuous white die-cut outline, with no separate floating pieces, sparkles or crumbs. The sticker fills most of the canvas with a small even margin. Style reference: the attached image is an approved sticker from the same set. Match its style exactly: the same bold eggplant outline weight, the same thick white die-cut border, the same flat colours with soft minimal shading, the same glossy highlight and the same very subtle drop shadow, at a similar size on the canvas. Use it only as a style guide: do not draw a tram or any part of it, and do not copy its colours where they differ from the palette above.
